turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm trying to figure out which transit pass to buy for the month.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Please wait until I've gone through all the options.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: One option is a monthly unlimited pass, which pays off if I ride more than about twice a day.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Another is a pay as you go card, which is cheaper if I only ride a few times a week.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or there's a weekly pass, which I could buy only for the weeks I'm busy.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: All set, those are the choices. Help me pick.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: How many days a week do you usually ride? If it's four or five, get the monthly pass. If it's only one or two, pay as you go is the way to go.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Right, next thing. I take terrible photos on hikes. Everything looks flat.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's often the light. Midday sun flattens everything. Early morning or late afternoon gives you shadows and warmer colours.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I can't always hike at those times.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Fair. Then try putting something in the foreground, like a rock, a tree or your friend, with the view behind. It adds depth straight away.
